title: Not worth $25
text: I was fairly disappointed when I received this. Every Saturday, I make an International dish from a different country and then mark it off on a map, so I was excited to get some new ideas, as well as spices that can be difficult or expensive to procure. However, all I received was a small spice packet and a sauce that looked like they were poured out of a big container into a smaller NOT SEALED container, a VERY cheap, plastic egg slicer, and two recipes. I can find recipes on the internet and everything else in the packet could have been purchased on Amazon for $10-$15 total. I immediately cancelled my subscription.
label: negative
